title: Errors axis labels a percentage as a total count
reasoning: The Errors panel plots the mean of error_passed / error_total multiplied by 100, but its axis reads 'Total Errors'. A value of 50 therefore describes a pass percentage while the chart presents it as an error count, reversing the likely interpretation of whether larger values are better.
reproduction: Supply one checkpoint with error_passed=1 and error_total=2. The Errors panel displays 50 on an axis labeled 'Total Errors'.
recommendation: Label the Errors axis as a pass percentage, consistent with the computed values and chart title.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No supplied tests check that panel axis units agree with the plotted statistics.
suggestedRegressionTest: Verify across all panels that plotted pass percentages and axis units agree, including the error-test panel.
minimumFixScope: The Errors panel axis title and chart unit-consistency coverage.
